offers_services.reason: Services such as ALD coating, calibration and maintenance support are secondary to equipment sales.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue mostly from capital equipment system sales; service and parts revenue is the smaller share.

cyclical_demand.reason: Semiconductor capital equipment orders are easily postponed by customers in downturns and follow fab capex cycles.

big_ticket.reason: Each MOCVD, ion beam or laser annealing system is a large, infrequent capital equipment purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured equipment and its technology, not mainly for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are large semiconductor and hard drive manufacturers and leading technology companies.

asset_heavy.reason: Equipment designer and assembler; growth needs R&D and moderate facilities, not fleets or networks.
